madaktu.basis: Overview of the Neo-Elamite royal city identified with Darreh Shahr; the Elamite city was attacked by Assyria and the Susiana plain passed to Persia with the fall of the empire.
madaktu.note: Author-interpreted contextual range from the cited overview, not a precise-year occupation or ownership finding. The Pleiades record carries no dated rows.

mycenae.basis: Overview of the Argolid town: declined after the Bronze Age but still inhabited; Herodotus lists the Mycenaeans among the Thermopylae contingent of 480 BC.
mycenae.note: Author-interpreted contextual range from the cited overview, not a precise-year occupation or ownership finding.
